_meta.name: Landing in India — arrival-logistics reel bank
_meta.rule: Every claim is sourced (see audit). null = honest scarcity (beat is skipped). Lines are single sentences, English, en-IN voice; no fares/numbers unless authoritatively confirmed.
_meta.spoken: Numbers are spelled out (edge-tts reads words cleanly); captions == voice.

national.visa: Most passports need an India e-Visa — sort it online before you fly.
national.sim: Get a tourist SIM at the arrivals counter — passport, visa, and one photo.
national.money: Use an ATM in arrivals, not the forex counters, and keep small notes.
national.taxi_safe: Take the official prepaid taxi, or an app cab from the marked zone.
national.scam: And if anyone says your hotel is closed, ignore them — it's a classic scam.
